description: Link to the 3D sketch studio: draw strokes in 3D space with a pen, finger or mouse — over a blank canvas or around a model — on a phone, tablet, foldable or desktop, and export to SVG, PSD, ORA or Blender. Free, in the browser, no account. Use it when the user wants to sketch an idea, mark up a design in 3D or make a concept drawing.
name: open_3d_sketch
title: Open the 3D sketch studio
